primary_sources.title: Anderson, Molina-Paris and Mottola, Cosmological Horizon Modes and Linear Response in de Sitter Spacetime
primary_sources.reviewed: Section I, equations (2)-(3), local contacts, and the distinction between metric-driven and independent state variations.
primary_sources.use: Response/source distinction. The nonzero-initial-amplitude map, affine source cancellation and finite-time versus thermal Ward comparison are derived here. No short-scale branch exclusion is adopted.

source_access: Primary HTML opened directly; no downloaded-byte digest claimed.
strongest_comparator: The retained ADM formula includes an independent covariance with metric amplitudes zero initially; the reconstruction note retains kinematic initial terms but does not prove their full coupled range cancellation. The preceding Ward completion treats pure thermal sources, not finite-time Laplace data.
hardest_step: Retain the initial amplitude contribution in the derivative-coupled covariance equation and the distinct initial readout contact; connect the affine reconstruction to the full coupled range; avoid imposing equilibrium bolt data on a finite-time transform.
new_consequence: The original causal preparation source is explicit in terms of admitted covariance and metric initial data. For compact initial metric jets the reconstruction offset changes the solution but contributes no full cokernel overlap. Fixed-HH exponential response has no independent bounded growing covariance source. Finite-time initial stresses obey extra Ward terms and need not satisfy thermal first-harmonic bolt behavior.
scope_boundary: No actual constrained initial-data image or adjoint profiles are evaluated. General trace formulas are finite-regulator or conditional renormalized form identities. Positivity, Hadamard/state matching, initial-surface regularity and physical metric boundary conditions are not inferred from them. Free covariance norm preservation does not prove coupled gravitational stability.
regulator_contract: Original action, state, domain, clock, flux and common subtraction remain fixed. Keep all residual and initial contacts. No new initial-surface term, finite counterterm, boundary prescription or order reduction is selected.
verification_scope: Exact nonzero-initial-amplitude covariance/readout identities, direct time-integral fixtures at two precisions, local initial-jet polynomial, full coupled affine range identity, and translated-pulse Laplace/Ward controls. Fixtures do not evaluate the charged continuum kernel.
